data: Shared original synthetic dispatch fixtures; no external data or requests.

rules.task: Compare three carrier pickup windows using one stable anchor.
rules.good: Carrier names share a left anchor.
rules.bad: Translate the middle name 24 CSS pixels; retain the same text, row geometry, and type.
rules.verification: Alignment residual is the maximum absolute deviation from the peer median; the measured residual is 24 CSS pixels in Bad.
rules.exception: Labels need not align when they do not share this declared comparison relationship.
rules.humanReview: Task relevance, correct grouping, equal priority, intentional anchors, and sufficient whitespace remain human judgments; measurements certify only the declared relationship.

rules.task: Review three equally related steps in one handoff checklist.
rules.good: Adjacent gaps are 12 and 12 CSS pixels.
rules.bad: Add 24 CSS pixels after the second step; gaps become 12 and 36.
rules.verification: Population standard deviation divided by mean gap is 0 in Good and 0.5 in Bad.
rules.exception: A real subgroup boundary may justify a larger gap; this fixture explicitly declares no subgroup.
rules.humanReview: Task relevance, correct grouping, equal priority, intentional anchors, and sufficient whitespace remain human judgments; measurements certify only the declared relationship.

rules.task: Expose more of the same release queue as usable comparison area grows.
rules.good: At 800 pixels show three shipments; at 1280 expose six, retaining the first three and readable type.
rules.bad: Retain the three-card layout so cards merely stretch at 1280 pixels.
rules.verification: Compare each page and checkpoint to its compact capture: fractional identity-count growth divided by fractional usable-region area growth. Bad has zero yield; Good exceeds 0.8.
rules.exception: A finite task with every declared identity visible can retain whitespace; the finite checkpoint supplies its complete three-key universe.
rules.humanReview: Task relevance, correct grouping, equal priority, intentional anchors, and sufficient whitespace remain human judgments; measurements certify only the declared relationship.

rules.task: Inspect three unselected carrier plans with equal task priority.
rules.good: Peer cards have equal border-box areas and heading type.
rules.bad: Allocate column widths in a 1:1.8:1 ratio; retain type, text, order, and total row width.
rules.verification: The area coefficient of variation is approximately 0.298 in Bad and zero in Good; heading font sizes remain equal.
rules.exception: Different priority or content needs may justify different areas; symmetry is never required.
rules.humanReview: Task relevance, correct grouping, equal priority, intentional anchors, and sufficient whitespace remain human judgments; measurements certify only the declared relationship.
